production_policy: No undocumented extra root keys without explicit revision
Initial host profile 1920x1080, 30/1; others require certified sequence profile
SRT required for narrative projects; real 64-hex checksum not placeholder
Voice audio required; validate decode and hash
If required=true need readable MP4; background audio mute unless explicit
Layout profile hash must match actual profile
May have documented metadata for crop/alpha/hash; no executable paths
semantic_relation, locked are documented optional historical metadata
stagger_frames and timing_lock optional if explicitly present
Other documented forms: word range, source_span, occurrence, confidence; no fabricated word timing
Read for compatibility, never launch standalone final FFmpeg export
Input READY status never overrides runtime preflight
Audit data only, may preserve documented extra keys
Global mode exactly BOTH; root no scene timing or asset path
Hash of runtime registry required; reject placeholder or mismatch
No enter_effect, exit_effect, enter_direction, exit_direction, in_ms or out_ms
Nonexecuting metadata; preserve exact source values
NO_ANIMATION_FIELDS
NO_SPLIT_EFFECTS
NO_SPLIT_OR_SCENE_DATA
NO_BLEEDING_EDIT_FIELDS
